prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE square detailed painterly naturalistic mythology encyclopedia illustration of Lyngbakr, heather-back from the Örvar-Odds saga. Elevated three-quarter cutaway water view: an ENORMOUS recognizably whale-shaped creature lies just under the translucent dark water of the Greenland Sea. Its rounded broad back protrudes above the water as an island covered with low heather and patches of grass. Through the clear foreground water show the continuous cetacean head with one visible eye, massive whale body and horizontal tail flukes, making the living whale beneath the island unmistakable. Scale vast against distant northern ocean. Chilling storm clouds and cold light, deceptively calm island above a sinister huge presence; naturalistic ominous awe, not cheerful animal portrait. One whale only, no people or ships or drowning scene. Do not add legs, tentacles, dragon horns, fangs or mixed sea-monster anatomy. Full main silhouette with margins. No text, diagrams, labels, borders, logos or watermark. Contemporary artistic interpretation based on the documented whale and heather-island variant.
visual_requirements: Whale head and flukes visible beneath water
depicted_variant: The immense whale-like Lyngbakr floating half-submerged with island-like heather growing across its exposed back.
aura: Vast deceptive oceanic threat, awe and dread beneath apparent tranquility.

visual_review.notes: Observed one enormous continuous whale body and cetacean head visible beneath translucent northern sea; broad back emerges as an island with grass and purple heather. Pectoral fin and horizontal tail establish whale anatomy, storm clouds and massive submerged presence convey deceptive oceanic menace. No dragon parts or extra creatures.
